Bugfixes== *[[Pursuit]] is now freeze immune. *[[Field Medic]] now gives enemies immunity to being frozen. *Freeze now has a 2.5 second cooldown before an enemy can be frozen again, with the cooldown starting the moment an enemy is frozen. *Burn now bypasses defense, with the only exception being the [[Archer]]'s burn. *Towers now can be quickly placed, which is similar to placing it down regularly but the tower's upgrade screen is not opened. *Default [[Cryomancer]] Level 0-3 appearance changed. *New Christmas lobby. *[[HP Locked]] now displays its rewards increase. *Changed [[Tommy Goon 2]] name from ''Body Guard'' to ''Tommy Goon''. *Removed [[Enemies Beta]] from [[Badlands II]], [[Polluted Wasteland II]], [[Pizza Party]], [[Oops! All slimes!]] and [[Jailed Towers (Challenge)|Jailed Towers]]. *Added [[Badlands (Modifier)|Badlands]] modifier to [[Oops! All slimes!]]. *Multiple health related fixes due to [[Enemies Beta]] being removed from [[Polluted Wasteland II]]: **[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] now has 800 health instead of 600. **[[Necromancer King|Necromancer Boss]] now has 60,000 health instead of 14,000. **[[Cursed Skeleton]] now has 2,500 health instead of 500 **[[Skeleton]] now has 55 health instead of 15, though it still does not have its original 60 health. *Fixed chillness damage not scaling properly with [[Time Scale]]. *Fixed [[Pursuit]]'s bottom path missile firerate being much slower than intended. *Fixed [[Gladiator]] being unable to attack enemies in range higher than 6. *Fixed [[Mercenary Base]] not summoning units in situations where when originally placed, it had no path in range, but even after gaining enough range to reach a path, it would not summon anything. *Fixed [[Engineer]] sentries not using their skins most of the time, instead using the Default one. *Fixed [[Cryomancer]] having the [[Pyromancer]]'s store description. *Fixed {{Color|Krampus|Dwarf}} [[Pyromancer]] skin using its Level 5 appearance at Level 4, now Level 4 has its own correct appearance. *Fixed [[Grenadier]]'s muzzle flare not appearing and its firing sound not playing when firing. *Fixed various issues with replication. *Fixed background music getting quieter even when dialogue audio is muted. *Fixed [[Tommy Goon 1]] being called ''Pistol Goon''. *Fixed [[Starter Bundle]] incorrectly displaying its discount as 211%, though it now incorrectly lists it as 47% instead of 53%. :In '''v1.46.1''':
